name: 10-Deacetylbaccatin III
evidence_summary: EPA documents extraction of 10-DAB from Taxus baccata leaves/twigs and semisynthesis of paclitaxel from it. Exact structure only.

name: Salicylic acid
evidence_summary: PubChem cites ChEBI for salicylic acid occurrence in white willow bark and wintergreen leaves. Natural occurrence does not establish that the salicylic acid supplied for any aspirin route was extracted; chemical synthesis of salicylic acid is also documented.
